main.description: A reusable, portable description of WHO a piece of gated content is for and HOW an entitled viewer obtains a decryption key. Deliberately free of foryour.fans database IDs and of any subscriber/billing data — a competing fan-service app must be able to implement its own payment relationship and its own key issuance from this record alone. See docs/creator-owned-pds.md.

audience.description: public: no gate. subscribers: any active paid subscription to this creator. tier: an active subscription at `minimumTier` or higher.

minimumTier.description: Required when audience is `tier`. A stable AT reference to a fans.foryour.tier record — never a local database id.

keyGrant.description: Present when the gated payload is encrypted. Describes the protocol a subscriber's client uses to request a content key.

bundle.description: Future-proofing hook for promotions/bundles: additional tier refs that also satisfy this policy. Empty/absent today.

uri.description: AT URI of the fans.foryour.tier record.

rkey.description: The tier record's rkey, denormalized so a resolver need not parse the URI.

keyGrantMethod.description: Contains NO key material and NO subscriber identities.

protocol.description: Key-grant protocol identifier. `foryour.fans/keygrant-v1`: POST the target content AT URI with a viewer DID auth token to `endpoint`; receive an entitlement-checked, per-content wrapped key.

endpoint.description: Key-grant HTTP endpoint. Absent means use the creator's fans.foryour.serviceConfig#keyGrantEndpoint.
